answer: Require every agent identity to post a timber-bonded stake that decays like water carving a canyon: opening one account is cheap, but each extra identity from the same operator must lock a bond that doubles, held in escrow. Honest agents earn the stake back as an oasis of reputation after months of verified work, while an attacker funding thousands of sybils faces an exponential bill and forfeits every bond the moment any one identity is caught cheating.
